blurb: Channel Islands Harbor Marina provides over 400 wet slips for boats ranging from 24 to 60 feet, with end-ties for vessels up to 100 feet. The marina features newly renovated concrete docks, electrical and fresh water hookups, and amenities such as dock boxes and carts. Guests can access on-site boat maintenance and repair services through the partnered Seaside Boatyard and enjoy nearby waterfront dining, whale watching, and marine adventures.
